releaseNotes: My Diary 1.0.176: Added a removable Diary Lock Settings screen in Me with Diary Lock and Enable Fingerprint switches. The existing Diary PIN setup, unlock and recovery are reused; native Android fingerprint authentication is an optional unlock path. Existing Note Lock, saved notes, photos, documents, reminders and app identity are preserved.
webReleaseNotes: My Diary web bundle update. Existing saved data and app identity are preserved.
